67247-the-real-question-as-to-altar-ligh.creator: Unknown
67247-the-real-question-as-to-altar-ligh.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. intimated his intention to transfer the place of holding his visitation at Sudbury, from S. Peter’s to All Saints, that is to say from a Church where to say nothing more, Morning and Evening Prayer are said daily throughout the year, to a Church where this most positive and essential Law of the Church, is wholly and habitually set at nought.

arxiv-1811-08586.title: Urban Driving with Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning Conference: Proc. of the 18th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2019); May 13–17, 2019; Montreal, Canada
arxiv-1811-08586.creator: Changjian Li, Krzysztof Czarnecki
arxiv-1811-08586.description: Abstract . Autonomous driving is a challenging domain that entails multiple aspects: a vehicle should be able to drive to its destination as fast as possible while avoiding collision, obeying traffic rules and ensuring the comfort of passengers. In this paper, we present a deep learning variant of thresholded lexicographic Q-learning for the task of urban driving.

arxiv-2201-11636.title: Automatic computation of Feynman integrals containing linear propagators via auxiliary mass flow
arxiv-2201-11636.creator: Zhi-Feng Liu, Yan-Qing Ma
arxiv-2201-11636.description: Abstract We proposed a recipe to systematically calculate Feynman integrals containing linear propagators using the auxiliary mass flow method. The key of the recipe is to introduce a quadratic term for each linear propagator and then using differential equations to get rid of their effects.

arxiv-2206-11275.title: paired : A Statistical Framework for Detecting Stellar Binarity with Gaia RVs. I. Sensitivity to Unresolved Binaries
arxiv-2206-11275.creator: Quadry Chance, Daniel Foreman-Mackey, Sarah Ballard, Andrew R. Casey, Trevor J. David, Adrian M. Price-Whelan
arxiv-2206-11275.description: Abstract Data Release 3 (DR3) from the Gaia Mission includes radial velocity measurements of over 33 million targets. Among many scientific applications, the overlap of this stellar sample with targeted exoplanet transit survey stars presents an opportunity to understand planet occurrence in the context of stellar multiplicity on a large scale.

arxiv-2208-12333.title: Open loci of ideals with applications to Birational maps
arxiv-2208-12333.creator: S. Hamid Hassanzadeh and Maral Mostafazadehfard
arxiv-2208-12333.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by S. Hamid Hassanzadeh and Maral Mostafazadehfard. In this work we show that the loci of ideals in principal class, ideals of grade at least two, and ideals of maximal analytic spread are Zariski open sets in the parameter space. As an application, we show that the set of birational maps of clear polynomial degree d d over an arbitrary projective variety X X , denoted by Bir ⁡ ( X ) d \Bir(X)_{d} , is a constructible set.

arxiv-2305-18906.title: Long-distance entanglement sharing using hybrid states of discrete and continuous variables
arxiv-2305-18906.creator: Soumyakanti Bose, Jaskaran Singh, Adán Cabello, Hyunseok Jeong
arxiv-2305-18906.description: Abstract We introduce a feasible scheme to produce high-rate long-distance entanglement which uses hybrid entanglement (HE) between continuous variables (CV) and discrete variables (DV). We show that HE can effectively remove the experimental limitations of existing CV and DV systems to produce long range entanglement. We benchmark the resulting DV entangled states using an entanglement-based quantum key distribution (EB-QKD) protocol.

arxiv-2406-08598.title: Language Model Council: Democratically Benchmarking Foundation Models on Highly Subjective Tasks
arxiv-2406-08598.creator: Justin Zhao, Flor Miriam Plaza-del-Arco, Benjamin Genchel, Amanda Cercas Curry
arxiv-2406-08598.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Justin Zhao, Flor Miriam Plaza-del-Arco, Benjamin Genchel, Amanda Cercas Curry. As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to evolve, evaluating them remains a persistent challenge. Many recent evaluations use LLMs as judges to score outputs from other LLMs, often relying on a single large model like GPT-4o. However, using a single LLM judge is prone to intra-model bias, and many tasks – such as those related to emotional intelligence, creative writing, and persuasiveness – may be too subjective for a single model to judge fairly.

arxiv-2408-04295.title: Assigning Credit with Partial Reward Decoupling in Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization
arxiv-2408-04295.creator: Aditya Kapoor, Benjamin Freed, Jeff Schneider, Howie Choset
arxiv-2408-04295.description: Abstract Multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) has recently demonstrated state-of-the-art performance on challenging multi-agent reinforcement learning tasks. However, MAPPO still struggles with the credit assignment problem, wherein the sheer difficulty in ascribing credit to individual agents’ actions scales poorly with team size.

arxiv-2412-08980.title: Cover numbers by certain graph families
arxiv-2412-08980.creator: Márton Marits
arxiv-2412-08980.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Márton Marits. We define the cover number of a graph G G by a graph class 𝒫 \mathcal{P} as the minimum number of graphs of class 𝒫 \mathcal{P} required to cover the edge set of G G .

arxiv-2501-06561.title: Where to Go Next Day: Multi-scale Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Model for Mid-term Human Mobility Prediction
arxiv-2501-06561.creator: Zongyuan Huang, Weipeng Wang, Shaoyu Huang, Marta C. González, Yaohui Jin, Yanyan Xu
arxiv-2501-06561.description: Abstract Predicting individual mobility patterns is crucial across various applications. While current methods mainly focus on predicting the next location for personalized services like recommendations, they often fall short in supporting broader applications such as traffic management and epidemic control, which require longer period forecasts of human mobility.

arxiv-2509-21236.title: Limitations on Morphological Fitting for JWST “Little Red Dots” Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2509-21236.creator: Kelly E. Whalen, Kimberly A. Weaver, Ryan C. Hickox, Erini Lambrides
arxiv-2509-21236.description: Abstract Early results from JWST uncover a peculiar class of objects referred to as “little red dots” (LRDs). The extremely compact morphology of LRDs is often invoked to point towards an AGN-dominated picture in the context of their conflicting multiwavelength properties.

marx-poverty-philosophy-quelch-1913.title: The Poverty of Philosophy
marx-poverty-philosophy-quelch-1913.creator: Karl Marx (Harry Quelch, trans.)
marx-poverty-philosophy-quelch-1913.description: Marx's 1847 demolition of Proudhon's Philosophy of Poverty — the founding polemic of Marxist political economy, countering utopian moralism with historical materialism. Harry Quelch's translation (Charles H. Kerr, Chicago, 1913).

pmc-10509699.title: Production of recombinant lumpy skin disease virus A27L and L1R proteins for application in diagnostics and vaccine development
pmc-10509699.creator: Nomfundo Ntombela, Matome Matsiela, Sbahle Zuma, Suhavna Hiralal, Leeann Naicker, Nobalanda Mokoena, Thandeka Khoza
pmc-10509699.description: Vaccination using live attenuated vaccines (LAVs) is considered the most effective method for control of lumpy skin disease (LSD). However, this method is limited by safety concerns, with reports of adverse reactions following vaccination. This study evaluates A27L and L1R which are essential proteins for virus attachment and membrane fusion as recombinant sub-unit vaccines against LSD.

pmc-10573427.title: Significance of Selected Environmental and Biological Factors on the Risk of FASD in Women Who Drink Alcohol during Pregnancy
pmc-10573427.creator: Elżbieta Grzywacz, Bogusław Brzuchalski, Małgorzata Śmiarowska, Damian Malinowski, Anna Machoy-Mokrzyńska, Monika Anna Białecka, Pietro Muratori
pmc-10573427.description: Prenatal alcohol exposure (PAE), which refers to alcohol consumption by pregnant women, is associated with the risk of numerous severe complications during fetal development. The State Agency for Alcohol Problem Solving reports that the incidence of fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD) in Poland’s general population is over 1.

pmc-11382169.title: Why rural teachers are in a poor working state: Double marginalization causes a lack of career identity and hope
pmc-11382169.creator: Xiaoxia Han, Jin Yao
pmc-11382169.description: Professional development for rural teachers is currently encountering numerous challenges, leading to poor working conditions characterized by a lack of hope. This condition affects not only the quality of rural education but also the physical and mental well-being and work efficiency of rural teachers themselves.

pmc-11516517.title: Advancing data-driven decision-making for human papillomavirus (HPV)
pmc-11516517.creator: L L Louette
pmc-11516517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundHPV is among the most important infections associated with cancers in men and women, including cervical cancer which is the second most common cancer affecting women aged 15-44 years in the EU.

pmc-11545957.title: The Impact of Neutrophil-to-High-Density Lipoprotein Ratio and Serum 25-Hydroxyvitamin D on Ischemic Heart Disease
pmc-11545957.creator: Ewelina A Dziedzic, Jakub S Gąsior, Kamila Koseska, Michał Karol, Ewa Czestkowska, Kamila Pawlińska, Wacław Kochman, Gian Luigi Nicolosi
pmc-11545957.description: Background: This study describes the complex association between the neutrophil-to-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio (NHR), 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25(OH)D) levels, and cardiovascular disease (CVD), such as stable ischemic heart disease (IHD), ST elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI), non–ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI), and unstable angina (UA).

pmc-12412621.title: Food Intake and Mental Health Among Middle School Students in Shandong Province: A Network Analysis
pmc-12412621.creator: Yisong Yao, Baoyi Liao, Jingjing Feng, Shiwei Tang, Ziyi Zhang, Dajun Yang, Xinrui Yin, Jiahong Xie, Ludan Yang, Wenwen Yin
pmc-12412621.description: PurposeA network analysis model was used to investigate the network structure linking food intake and mental health among middle school students in Shandong Province from a specific symptom perspective.MethodsA total of 6179 middle school students aged 11–18 years in Shandong Province were included in the study.

pmc-12471749.title: Ocular Surface Changes Associated with Neurological Diseases
pmc-12471749.creator: Reda Zemaitiene, Gigi Gorgadze, Laura Mockaitiene, Dejan Jakimovski
pmc-12471749.description: Neurological disorders significantly affect ocular surface homeostasis, influencing parameters such as blink rate (BR), tear production, corneal nerve density, and sensitivity. This review summarizes recent findings on ocular surface alterations associated with neurological diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS), trigeminal neuralgia (TN), multiple sclerosis (MS), and Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease (CMT).

pmc-12594659.title: Using glucagon receptor antagonism to evaluate the physiological effects of extrapancreatic glucagon in totally pancreatectomised individuals: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-12594659.creator: Caroline Trunk-Black Juel, Asger B. Lund, Sofie Hædersdal, Maria M. Andersen, Carsten P. Hansen, Jan H. Storkholm, Gerrit van Hall, Bolette Hartmann, Mette M. Rosenkilde, Camilla J. Kibsgaard, Flemming Dela, Nicolai J. Wewer Albrechtsen, Jens J. Holst, Tina Vilsbøll, Filip K. Knop
pmc-12594659.description: Aims/hypothesisPrevious studies have indicated that 29-amino-acid glucagon (i.e. ‘pancreatic’ glucagon) circulates in totally pancreatectomised individuals and that a postprandial glucagon response can be detected. Using a glucagon receptor antagonist (GRA), we investigated the possible role of extrapancreatic glucagon on glucose, lipid and amino acid metabolism in totally pancreatectomised individuals.

pmc-12628965.title: Time to initial glycopeptide therapy and 30-day mortality in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12628965.creator: Tae-Hoon No, Seok Jun Mun
pmc-12628965.description: BackgroundThe optimal time cut-off for appropriate antibiotic therapy (AAT) in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bacteremia remains uncertain. We assessed the effects of time to AAT on 30-day in-hospital mortality in patients with MRSA bacteremia who received glycopeptides as initial therapy, and applied landmark analyses to adjust for immortal-time bias.

pmc-12664006.title: Contractile forces direct the chiral swirling of minimal cell collectives
pmc-12664006.creator: Ghina Badih, Alexandre Schaeffer, Benoît Vianay, Pauline Smilovici, Laurent Blanchoin, Manuel Théry, Laëtitia Kurzawa
pmc-12664006.description: SignificanceChirality, a fundamental property of living systems, manifests in cell collectives by their biased directional swirling. Despite the identification of the actomyosin cytoskeleton in driving the internal chiral symmetry break occurring in cells, little is known about the role of cellular forces in the development of handedness in collectives.

pmc-12665290.title: Posterior Circulation Stroke in a Patient With May-Thurner Syndrome and Patent Foramen Ovale: A Case of Paradoxical Embolism
pmc-12665290.creator: Carlos A Suanes Zubizarreta, Michael Sinnott, Zehra Rizvi, Roberto Sanchez, Ariol Labrada
pmc-12665290.description: Posterior circulation strokes can present with a range of subtle or fluctuating symptoms, often delaying diagnosis and complicating treatment decisions. We present the case of a 59-year-old woman with a prior history of transient ischemic attack (TIA), ischemic stroke, and antiphospholipid syndrome who was brought to the emergency department with acute dysarthria, vertigo, tinnitus, and vomiting.

pmc-13223778.title: Cooperative membrane association as a mechanistic origin of synergistic antimicrobial peptide activity
pmc-13223778.creator: Angela Medvedeva, Anatoly B. Kolomeisky
pmc-13223778.description: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are central components of the innate immunity system that can be found in almost all living organisms. They are promising alternatives to conventional antibiotics due to their broad-spectrum activity and reduced susceptibility to resistance. Experimental studies have shown that combinations of AMPs can act synergistically, achieving enhanced antibacterial efficacy at lower total concentrations in combination than individually.

pmc-13313903.title: Prevalence of subclinical mastitis and associated biosecurity practices in peri-urban dairy farms
pmc-13313903.creator: Sutiastuti Wahyuwardani, Sri Suryatmiati Prihandani, Raphaella Widiastuti, Prima Mei Widiyanti, Yessi Anastasia, Eny Martindah, Romsyah Maryam, Susan Maphilindawati Noor, Rini Damayanti, Yulvian Sani, Aswin Rafif Khairullah, Eni Siti Rohaeni, Priyono Priyono
pmc-13313903.description: Background:Subclinical mastitis (SCM) is a major constraint in peri-urban smallholder dairy production. Inconsistent biosecurity and milking hygiene may increase infection risk and productivity losses.Aim:This study aimed to assess the association between biosecurity practices (external, internal, and procedural) and SCM prevalence and severity in peri-urban dairy farms in Greater Jakarta (Jakarta, Bogor Regency, Bogor City, and Depok), Indonesia.

pmc-13397639.title: Gender inequality in the impact of climate shock on physical health and its spillover effect
pmc-13397639.creator: Hongkun Zhao, Zhuo Chen
pmc-13397639.description: BackgroundPhysical health disparities between male and female constitute a significant yet underexplored manifestation of gender inequality, a challenge increasingly exacerbated by climate shock.MethodsThis paper explores the gender inequality in the impact of climate shock on physical health and its spillover effect.

pmc-13434651.creator: Yuhan Zhou, Jing Li, Fangfang Liu, Yuan Gao, Songlin Yin, Liguo Yang, Xiaoxiao Li, Junhong Lin, Yan Li, Haotian Shang, Xiang Cheng, Tengfei Chao, Qian Chu, Fujia Lu, Weimin Wang
